plan.summary:
Limits concurrent uploads to four at a time.

- Adds the `p-limit` dependency.
- `uploadAll` now wraps each `putObject` call in a `pLimit(4)` limiter instead of starting all uploads at once with `Promise.all`.
plan.riskRationale: Small change with a well-known library. It changes upload concurrency only. A rejected upload still rejects `Promise.all`, as before.
plan.storyArc: Uploads used to start all at once. The change adds a concurrency limiter. One topic covers the dependency and its use together.

topics.title: Cap upload concurrency at four with p-limit
topics.narrativeBrief: How does `uploadAll` now limit parallel uploads? Connect the `pLimit(4)` wrapper around each `putObject` call to the new import and the `p-limit` dependency. Verify that error behavior stays the same.
